name: Auxiliary closing tool
summary: An auxiliary utility EA for MetaTrader 5 that provides automated closing functionality for existing positions. It does not open trades on its own but assists traders in managing and closing positions based on configurable conditions such as profit targets, loss limits, or other criteria.
summary_zh: 一个MetaTrader 5辅助工具EA，提供自动平仓功能。它不会自行开仓，而是根据可配置的条件（如盈利目标、亏损限制等）帮助交易者管理和关闭持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个辅助平仓工具，不具备自主交易策略，不会根据市场信号开仓。其主要功能是监控现有持仓并根据预设条件执行平仓操作，例如达到目标盈利、触及止损线、或满足时间条件等。仓位管理方面，该工具仅负责平仓而非开仓，因此不涉及仓位大小计算。资金管理通过设置盈利目标和最大亏损限制来实现保护性功能。整体而言，这是一个辅助性质的工具，用于帮助交易者自动化平仓流程，减少手动操作的延迟和情绪干扰，提高交易纪律性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is an auxiliary closing tool that does not possess an autonomous trading strategy and will not open positions based on market signals. Its primary function is to monitor existing positions and execute closing operations based on preset conditions such as reaching profit targets, hitting stop loss levels, or satisfying time-based criteria. In terms of position management, the tool only handles closing rather than opening, so it does not involve lot size calculations. Money management is implemented through protective features like profit targets and maximum loss limits. Overall, this is an auxiliary utility designed to help traders automate the closing process, reducing manual operation delays and emotional interference while improving trading discipline.

parameters.name: ProfitTarget
parameters.description_en: Target profit amount for closing all positions

parameters.name: LossLimit
parameters.description_en: Maximum loss amount for closing all positions

parameters.name: CloseAllOnFriday
parameters.description_en: Whether to close all positions on Friday

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number filter for order selection

pros: 自动化平仓流程，减少人为操作延迟
可配置的盈利和亏损阈值，保护账户资金
辅助性质不干扰主策略的持仓逻辑
支持按魔术号筛选持仓，可与多个EA配合使用
减少情绪化交易决策，提高交易纪律性
pros_en: Automates the closing process, reducing manual operation delays
Configurable profit and loss thresholds protect account capital
Auxiliary nature does not interfere with main strategy position logic
Supports filtering positions by magic number for use with multiple EAs
Reduces emotional trading decisions and improves trading discipline
cons: 依赖主策略的开仓质量，自身无法判断入场时机
平仓条件设置不当可能导致过早平仓或亏损扩大
缺乏高级风控功能如追踪止损或分批平仓
作为辅助工具功能相对单一，无法替代完整的交易管理系统
网络延迟或服务器断连时可能无法及时执行平仓
cons_en: Depends on the quality of the main strategy's entries, cannot judge entry timing itself
Improperly set closing conditions may lead to premature exits or expanded losses
Lacks advanced risk management features like trailing stops or partial closing
As a utility its functionality is relatively limited, cannot replace a full trade management system
Network latency or server disconnection may prevent timely position closing
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能以动态保护盈利
支持分批平仓策略，允许部分平仓锁定利润同时保留剩余仓位
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to dynamically protect profits
Support partial closing strategies, allowing position scaling out while keeping remaining exposure

risk_points: 平仓条件配置错误可能导致意外全部平仓
极端市场条件下滑点可能导致实际平仓价格偏离预期
risk_points_en: Misconfigured closing conditions may cause unexpected full position closure
Extreme market slippage may cause actual closing prices to deviate from expected levels

summary_en: An auxiliary utility EA for MetaTrader 5 that provides automated closing functionality for existing positions. It does not open trades on its own but assists traders in managing and closing positions based on configurable conditions such as profit targets, loss limits, or other criteria.
